country: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
South Georgia and South Sandwich Islands

fields.climate: variable, with mostly westerly winds throughout the year interspersed with periods of calm; nearly all precipitation falls as snow
fields.terrain: most of the islands are rugged and mountainous rising steeply from the sea; South Georgia is largely barren with steep, glacier-covered mountains…
fields.hazards: the South Sandwich Islands have prevailing weather conditions that generally make them difficult to approach by ship; they are also subject to active volcanism
fields.legal: the laws of the UK apply
